headline: God of War Sons of Sparta: the surprise 2D game
title: God of War Sons of Sparta Explained | Surprise 2D God of War Game
video_script: Did you know there's a 2D God of War? God of War Sons of Sparta was shadow dropped on PlayStation 5 on February twelfth, twenty twenty six, right at the end of a State of Play. It's a Metroidvania style side scroller about young Kratos in Sparta, made by Mega Cat Studios with Santa Monica Studio, and Bear McCreary wrote the music. Reviews were mixed to positive. Have you played it? Comment below!
